notes.subject: הורי
notes.rationale: 'ba bego ba tswalwa pele ga nna' (my progenitors, KJV/JPS) kgahlanong le 'batsadi' kapa 'ba ntataho' — popego ya mobu (construct) e buša bothata

notes.subject: נזיר
notes.rationale: 'yo a kgethilwego' (separate, KJV) kgahlanong le 'mokgethwa/kgoši' (prince, JPS/Rashi) goba 'Munazirite'

notes.subject: ⟨ke⟩/⟨tša⟩
notes.rationale: Sepedi e nyaka dikgopanyo tša sesupo seo Seheberu se se latelago ka mokgwa wa popego ya mobu

notes.subject: go Yosefa
notes.rationale: Yaakobo a bolelela morwa wa gage ka boena — dungo la go mo laka

translation: Dihumišo tša ntataho di feteletše dihumišo tša bao ba bego ba tswalwa pele ga nna, go fihla mopeleto wa dithaba tša nako e sa felego; di tla dula go hlogo ya Yosefa, le go thebe ya hlogo ya yo a kgethilwego go ba ne.

tokens.gloss: tša bao ba bego ba tswalwa pele ga nna
